semantics.precision_scope: One source-supplied point for the named Zunz data-center/substation project, linked to Finca1534/Padrón33. It is not a surveyed point, building footprint, campus boundary, entrance, or separate utility-only site. No arithmetic centroid or imagery-derived coordinate.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: MADES gives no source-specific positional-accuracy estimate or point-placement method; decimal digits do not imply survey accuracy.

distinctness_review.method: Point equality for Point features; segment-boundary and ray-casting containment against all Polygon/MultiPolygon exterior rings and holes. No centroid-only test. Baseline184 source names, country labels and physical keys were also read in full.
distinctness_review.identity_rule: One physical campus across original completed200MW data-center phases and its ongoing electrical expansion. The substation is not counted as a second standalone utility site. Valenzuela/W3X is distinct and not selected here.
